detail.longDescription: Guides to setting up OpenAlex queries are listed below. You can get a free API key for it and using the API burns up your daily usage quota at around one-tenth the rate that doing the same query via the web interface uses. OQL (OpenAlex Query Language) help: https:// help.openalex.org/api/oql/ Documents some search filters only available on paid plans also: https:// github.com/ourresearch/openale x-help/blob/main/content/api/filtering.md https:// github.com/ourresearch/openale x-docs/blob/main/how-to-use-the-api/get-groups-of-entities.md https:// github.com/ourresearch/openale x-docs/blob/main/api-guide-for-llms.md # research # science # humanities # OpenAlex
